info.name: Mainland Solar API NEW
info.description:
Complete API collection — authentication, products, cart, orders, Paystack payments, audit bookings, addresses, wishlist and reviews.

Collection variables are auto-saved by test scripts:
- access_token / refresh_token  → set on Login & Refresh Token
- reset_token                   → set on Verify Reset OTP
- cart_token                    → set on every cart response

Base URL: {{base_url}}  (default: http://localhost:5000)
